invariants.rationale: The method immediately throws an exception if width is null; thus, it must be non-null for normal execution.
The method throws an exception if height is null, so height must also be non-null at normal method entry.

invariants.expression: width != height || width == null || height == null
invariants.rationale: width and height can be the same or different Value objects, but if they are distinct, this relation covers all cases respecting null safety.
